say.ICP-OES: I C P O E S

lines.text: The fume hood's base holds the chemical waste: a vented cabinet for the solvents and one for the acids, with an intake tray above for the capped bottles the robots bring.
lines.spoken: The fume hood's base holds the chemical waste: a vented cabinet for the solvents and one for the acids, with an intake tray above for the capped bottles the robots bring.
lines.phonemes: ðə fjˈuːm hˈʊdz bˈeɪs hˈoʊldz ðə kˈɛmɪkəl wˈeɪst: ɐ vˈɛntᵻd kˈæbᵻnət fɚðə sˈɑːlvənts ænd wˈʌn fɚðɪ ˈæsɪdz, wɪð ɐn ˈɪnteɪk tɹˈeɪ əbˌʌv fɚðə kˈæpt bˈɑːɾəlz ðə ɹˈoʊbɑːts bɹˈɪŋ.

base.en.heard: The fume hoods base holds the chemical waste, a vented cabinet for the solvents and one for the acids, with an intake tray above for the capped bottles the robots bring.

lines.text: The CubXL's second pipette, the proposed P300, now puts the test's two hundred microlitres of seawater on the powder in one transfer. The small one alone took ten.
lines.spoken: The Cub X L's second pipette, the proposed P300, now puts the test's two hundred microlitres of seawater on the powder in one transfer. The small one alone took ten.
lines.phonemes: ðə kˈʌb ˈɛks ˈɛlz sˈɛkənd pɪpˈɛt, ðə pɹəpˈoʊzd pˈiː θɹˈiːhˈʌndɹɪd, nˈaʊ pˌʊts ðə tˈɛsts tˈuː hˈʌndɹɪd mˈaɪkɹoʊlˌiːɾɚz ʌv sˈiːwɔːɾɚɹ ɔnðə pˈaʊdɚɹ ɪn wˈʌn tɹˈænsfɜː. ðə smˈɔːl wˈʌn ɐlˈoʊn tˈʊk tˈɛn.

base.en.heard: The Cub XL's second pipette, the proposed P300, now puts the test's 200 microliters of seawater on the powder in one transfer. The small one alone took 10.

lines.text: Liquid waste leaves a station in the capped bottle it was made in, one class a trip. At the fume hood the arm sets it in the intake tray, under the sash, and takes an empty back. It never opens or pours.
lines.spoken: Liquid waste leaves a station in the capped bottle it was made in, one class a trip. At the fume hood the arm sets it in the intake tray, under the sash, and takes an empty back. It never opens or pours.
lines.phonemes: lˈɪkwɪd wˈeɪst lˈiːvz ɐ stˈeɪʃən ɪnðə kˈæpt bˈɑːɾəl ɪt wʌz mˌeɪd ˈɪn, wˈʌn klˈæs ɐ tɹˈɪp. æt ðə fjˈuːm hˈʊd ðɪ ˈɑːɹm sˈɛts ɪɾ ɪnðɪ ˈɪnteɪk tɹˈeɪ, ˌʌndɚ ðə sˈæʃ, ænd tˈeɪks ɐn ˈɛmpti bˈæk. ɪt nˈɛvɚɹ ˈoʊpənz ɔːɹ pˈɔːɹz.

base.en.heard: Liquid waste leaves a station in the capped bottle it was made in, one class a trip. At the fume hood, the arm sets it in the intake tray under the sash and takes an empty back. It never opens or pours.

lines.text: A person moves the bottles into the hood's vented cabinets each day shift: solvents on the left, acids on the right, a shelf apart.
lines.spoken: A person moves the bottles into the hood's vented cabinets each day shift: solvents on the left, acids on the right, a shelf apart.
lines.phonemes: ɐ pˈɜːsən mˈuːvz ðə bˈɑːɾəlz ˌɪntʊ ðə hˈʊdz vˈɛntᵻd kˈæbᵻnəts ˈiːtʃ dˈeɪ ʃˈɪft: sˈɑːlvənts ɔnðə lˈɛft, ˈæsɪdz ɔnðə ɹˈaɪt, ɐ ʃˈɛlf ɐpˈɑːɹt.

base.en.heard: A person moves the bottles into the hood's vented cabinets each day shift. Solvents on the left, acids on the right, a shelf apart.

lines.text: Powder waste stays by the atomizer: a vacuum and a pail for each alloy family, a bucket for sweepings, used filters in dry sand. A person seals and carries the liners; powder never rides a robot.
lines.spoken: Powder waste stays by the atomizer: a vacuum and a pail for each alloy family, a bucket for sweepings, used filters in dry sand. A person seals and carries the liners; powder never rides a robot.
lines.phonemes: pˈaʊdɚ wˈeɪst stˈeɪz baɪ ðɪ ˈæɾəmˌaɪzɚ: ɐ vˈækjuːm ænd ɐ pˈeɪl fɔːɹ ˈiːtʃ ˈælɔɪ fˈæmɪli, ɐ bˈʌkɪt fɔːɹ swˈiːpɪŋz, jˈuːzd fˈɪltɚz ɪn dɹˈaɪ sˈænd. ɐ pˈɜːsən sˈiːlz ænd kˈæɹiz ðə lˈaɪnɚz; pˈaʊdɚ nˈɛvɚ ɹˈaɪdz ɐ ɹˈoʊbɑːt.

base.en.heard: Powder waste stays by the atomizer. A vacuum and a pail for each alloy family, a bucket for sweepings, used filters in dry sand. A person seals and carries the liners. Powder never rides a robot.
